Commentary.Commentary: So we are done and dusted with the warm-ups. They have served well as an appetizer, now it's time for the main event. We are just a couple of days away from the beginning of the biggest event in world cricket. Hosts England take on South Africa in the opener of the World Cup on 30th May. That game will begin at 1030 local (0930 GMT). Make sure you join us for that one. Till then, Cheers!

Virat Kohli says the biggest positive to come out of the game was how KL Rahul batted at number 4. He says that KL is a great guy and needs confidence. Also praises Dhoni as well as the bowlers who played their best game in this one. Suggests it could be tricky to decide what to do first in these conditions as it does get better to bat in the second innings whereas there is spin as well. But the Indian skipper feels that the swing in the morning is very important and can decide how the game pans out at time. Regarding Rohit and Dhawan, Virat mentions that they wanted to bat second today but he is not too worried about them as they are quality players. Kohli admits that with so much cricket, warm-up games might not be that motivating for some. States that 50-over games can be difficult and that today the last 15 overs were challenging on the field, especially because they were running through the motions as there was no contest. He though tells that in case it is the real World Cup going on, there will be no lack of intensity.

Bangladesh skipper, Mashrafe Mortaza says that after Ireland and this game they have had enough match practice for the last 4 weeks. States that there are some small niggles but they want to take care of the bowlers considering the first match is just two days away for them. Reckons that their top order is batting well and different people are putting their hands up at the right time, and hopes they will know their roles come the group stage.

Earlier in the day, India after being put into bat put 359 runs on the board courtesy brilliant tons from KL Rahul and MS Dhoni. After the top order collapsed the two put on a 164-run stand for the 5th wicket and put on a massive total on the board.

As for India's bowling, 7 bowlers were used in total. Hardik Pandya did not bowl any over in this game and the four seamers, Bumrah, Bhuvneshwar, Shami and Vijay Shankar bowled just 20 overs between them. Jasprit Bumrah was the only pacer though to get into the wickets column with his 2. The day though belonged to the Indian spinners, especially the two front-line wrist spinners. Chahal and Kuldeep bowled 20 overs amongst themselves and picked up 3 wickets each. Jadeja too picked up a wicket in his 9.3 overs. But Kuldeep picking up wickets would have boosted his confidence after he was going through a lean patch. Overall it was a good day for the Indian players ahead of the start of the mega event.

Chasing 360, Bangladesh got off to a solid start, with both openers, Soumya Sarkar and Liton Das getting off the blocks quickly. Sarkar though could not continue and was dismissed to Bumrah. Shakib who came next went out for a golden duck. Rahim and Liton Das though then steadied the ship with a 120 run-stand with both batsmen getting to their respective fifties. But after that Bangladesh kept losing wickets in regular intervals and never actually looked to get close to India's total.

Comprehensive victory for India in the end. This match has cancelled out any fears Indian supporters and think-tank would have had regarding the team. Bangladesh, meanwhile, have a few things to think about and would be hoping that it was just a one-off before the World Cup.

OUT! He is well short! Dinesh Karthik has removed the bails and the dive from Mehidy will not save him. INDIA WIN BY 95 RUNS!!! A flatter ball on middle, another huge swipe across the line from Rubel and he misses again. The ball goes off the pads and between slip and keeper. The batsmen complete 2 leg byes easily but Mehidy wants the third to come back on strike. The fielder in the deep throws to the keeper's end where Karthik removes the bails and appeals. The square leg umpire takes it upstairs and the replays show us that this ball will be final one of the World Cup warm-ups! A commanding performance from India!
Run out appeal taken up! The batsmen try to take three runs and might have ended up being run out here. Mehidy dived but looked short to the naked eye. Let's see what the replays have to say!
Another flatter one on middle and leg, going down leg with the angle. Hossain misses the hoick and gets it on the pads.
Flatter off-spinner on middle, safely defended by Rubel.
Ravindra Jadeja to bowl the final over of the warm-ups.
Another one fired in on middle, pushed to mid-wicket where Jadeja stops it again. Chahal ends with figures of 10-0-55-3!
Flatter one on middle, Mehidy comes down the track and pushes this ball towards mid on. The mid-wicket fielder runs to his left and stops the ball.
Rubel Hossain walks out at number 11.

OUT! Chahal gets his third of the day. He tosses it up outside off, Saifuddin looks to heave it over the leg side but gets a top edge which lobs up towards the point region. Kuldeep runs to his left and takes a good catch. The wrist spinners have had a good game.
Floated on the pads, Saifuddin looks to flick but gets hit on the pads.
On the pads, Mehidy flicks it to mid-wicket  and gets one.
WIDE! Straighter one outside off. It is on the wrong side of the tramline. Wide signalled.
Short outside off, Mehidy cuts it to the man at point.
Bouncer on middle, Saifuddin looks to pull this away but misses the ball. An eventful over comes to an end.

NOT OUT! The batsman was in easily. A length ball on middle, driven towards mid on. The mid-wicket fielder runs to his left, picks up the ball and fires a direct hit at the bowler's end. The batsman though is easily in and the umpire just takes it upstairs to check the same. Replays roll in and show it is not out.

Six runs! Overthrows! Mehidy looks to punch this ball away but it goes away fine on leg side off the inside edge. Rahul there runs to pick up the ball but the batsmen come back for the second. The throw though is a really wild one and hence it runs away to the fence with no one backing up in that angle. 6 runs totally and Kohli is not pleased!
Run out appeal taken upstairs. Mehidy Hasan is the man in question. He looks to be home let's see what the replays have to say though.

NOT OUT! The ball is pitching outside leg, just as one felt! India lose the review. A length ball bowled outside leg, Saifudding misses the ball as he looks to flick it away. The ball goes onto the thigh pad and Shankar appeals but it is turned down. Meanwhile the batsmen have run for a leg bye. Virat Kohli takes this upstairs though but the replays confirm the umpire can stay with his original decision.
Review time! An LBW appeal from Shankar is turned down by the umpire. It looked like it pitched outside leg to the naked eye. Let us see what the replays have to say!
Short ball on middle, mistimed pull towards deep square leg by Mehidy. Dhoni from the deep runs in and stops it at a single. Has a smile on his face as well.
Back of a length on off, pushed away to mid-wicket by Saifuddin. A single is taken.
SIX! What a shot! Mehidy showing he is no mug with the bat. A flighted ball outside off, Hasan runs down the track and lifts the ball over the bowler's head. Into the sightscreen!
Flatter outside off, driven hard by Hasan to cover.
Pushed away to deep cover this time by Saifuddin. The ball from around the wicket is easily dealt with by the left-hander.
Mehidy runs down the track and pushes this to long off for a single.
Poor fielding! Short outside off, cut away by Hasan towards the left of point. Bhuvneshwar dives but does not stop the ball. A couple is hence taken.
Flighted on middle and leg, turned away through square leg by the southpaw. Single taken.
Length ball outside off, MS guides it to third man and gets one.

Full on off, Saifuddin drives it towards cover and gets a single. The fielder has a shy at the bowler's end and he hits. The batsman was in though and the ball deflects off the stumps and they get one more.
Now follows it up with a solid leave outside off.
FOUR! Brute power here from Saifuddin. Shankar bowls it on a length outside off, Saifuddin smashes it through mid off for a boundary.
On middle, Mehidy flicks it to fine leg and gets one.
Bends his back and bowls it short. Saifuddin pulls it to deep square leg and gets one.
Vijay Shankar to have a go now.
Floated on off, Saifuddin drives it towards cover and gets one.
This time sweeps it to square leg for one.
Short on off, Hasan pulls it to mid-wicket.
Short again this time Hasan cuts it to point.
Flighted on off, Mehidy defends it.
Short outside off, Mehidy slaps it straight to point.
Yuzvendra Chahal comes back on.
On the stumps, Saifuddin defends it to see off the over. Kuldeep ends with 3/47!
Comes over the wicket and bowls it full on off, Saifuddin blocks it.
Comes around the wicket and bowls it full on off, Saifuddin drives it straight to mid off.
Flights it on off, MS defends it.
Tossed up on off, Saifuddin taps it back to the bowler.
Flighted on middle, Mehidy sweeps it to mid-wicket and gets one.
Mehidy comes down the track and pushes this ball down to long on for a single.
The batsman has played it to the point region.

Flatter outside off, Mehidy looks to sweep this ball away but misses and gets rapped low on the pads. Impact is outside off and hence the umpire declines the appeal. Virat Kohli looks to his players for a review consideration but then does not take it.
Flighted this time on off, defended watchfully by Hasan coming ahead.
Another flatter one on middle, driven abck to the bowler again.
Bowled quicker and full on middle, Mehidy pushes this ball back to the bowler.

Wonderful ball this. Kuldeep gives it nice air and loops it up on off. Saifuddin is tempted to drive and he cannot resist it. The ball spins away after pitching,he gets a thick outside edge which falls short of Rohit Sharma at first slip. It goes past him and they take two.
Flighted on the pads, Saifuddin plays it with the spin towards mid-wicket and gets a single.
Shorter on off, Saifuddin punches it to the man at cover.
On the pads, Mehidy flicks it to square leg and gets one.
Shorter outside off, spinning away from the batsman. Mehidy plays it with the turn towards third man region. Vijay Shankar goes after it and stops it before the rope. They take two runs.
Full on the pads, the southpaw nudges it to long on and gets a single.
Another one fired in on the pads, turned towards square leg by the southpaw. Saifuddin gets off the mark.
Mehidy gets off the mark with a tucked shot towards square leg.
Fired in on middle, defends this towards the left of the bowler.
Flatter off-spinner outside off, Hasan defends it on the front foot to point.
Mehidy Hasan walks out to bat next.

OUT! They are falling like nine-pins now. A flatter one on off, fired in quick by Jadeja as he sees Sabbir backing away. The batsman wanted to cut this away but gets an inside edge onto the off stump. The Tigers have lost 3 wickets for no run!
The batsman shows the full face of the bat and defends the ball off the back foot towards cover.
Powerplay 3 time! 5 fielders will be allowed outside the 30-yard circle till the end now. 144 needed in 60 now.
Flighted on the stumps, MS blocks it to see off the over.
On the stumps, Saifuddin once again defends it.
No hat-trick for Kuldeep either. Saifuddin has defended off the front foot.
Mohammad Saifuddin is in next. He will face the third hat-trick ball of this innings!

OUT! Two in two. Third time in this innings a bowler is on a hat-trick. The last one was flighted and spinning in to the right-hander. This one spins away from the batter. Hossain comes down the track to stroke it. He misses it completely and Dinesh Karthik behind the stumps takes the bails off in a flash. Third wicket in this game for Kuldeep. Dhoni with the bat and Kuldeep now with the ball. The warning has been sent to the rest of the teams. Can he get a hat-trick now?
Mosaddek Hossain walks out to bat at number 8.

OUT! Mushfiqur Rahim departs in the nervous 90. Just as they say one brings another and that's the case here for Kuldeep. He wonderfully flights this one on middle and off. It spins in to the right-hander. Rahim looks to play the sweep but the ball goes between the bat and pad and onto the stumps. End of a really nice knock from the Bangladeshi wicket-keeper batsman though!
Flighted on off, Sabbir defends it with soft hands towards cover and takes a quick single.

Mushfiqur works this ball through mid-wicket. Two runs are picked up easily by the batsmen. 14 runs off this over, a big one for Bangladesh. They need many of these if they are to win this game. 145 needed in 66 balls now. Rahim moves into the 90s with that couple.
The batsman defends it from within the crease to the point fielder.
Rahim wanted to come inside the line and pull that away but Jadeja fires it quick outside off. MR has to defend it towards the left of the bowler.
SIX! 4, 2 and 6 off the first 3 balls! A flatter one on middle, Rahim comes well ahead before slog-sweeping this ball over deep square leg. The ball crosses the rope with ease.
Fired in on middle, Mushfiqur flicks this away wide of long on. Rohit mops up in the deep but the batsmen pick two runs easily.
FOUR! A drag down from Jadeja, pulled away past short fine leg for a boundary by Rahim. Good shot.
MS Dhoni goes off now, Dinesh Karthik comes back on as a keeper, probably for the remainder of the game!
Defends off the front foot to see off the over.

NOT OUT! Height is not the factor but it umpire's call so Sabbir survives. Not a bad review this. Flighted ball pitching on leg, Sabbir looks to play the reverse sweep but misses. The ball hits him on the front foot. Kohli, Dhoni and Kuldeep discuss about the review. Kohli asks whether height is an issue but Kuldeep is confident height is not the factor. Kohli finally takes the review. Replays roll in and Hawk Eye shows that the ball was going onto clip the leg pole. So it stays with the on field umpire's call.

Review time! A LBW appeal against Sabbir has been turned down. The ball was spinning in after landing outside off, probably was hitting in line as well. Looks like height could be the only factor! Let us see what the replays have to say...
Flighted on off, Rahim milks it to long off for another easy run.
Tossed up on middle, Sabbir nudges it to long on for one.
FOUR! Tossed up on off, Sabbir gets on one knee and sweeps it through square leg for a boundary.
Floats it on off, Sabbir looks to defend but gets a leading edge.
Flatter one on middle, Rahim comes ahead to defend but the ball goes off the leading edge towards cover.
The batsman got into position early and reverse swept that one but straight to the short third man fielder.

What a brilliant piece of fielding! Saves 2 runs for his side with his athleticism does Rohit Sharma in the deep. A short ball on middle, Rahim pulls this over mid-wicket. A long chase for Rohit as he runs to his right from long on towards cow corner. He puts in a superb dive and flicks the ball inside. 2 runs are taken.
Flighted outside off, Rahman leans into this drive and gets it away to deep cover for a single.
Pushed to cover by Sabbir this time.
Flatter on the pads, tucked away to deep fine leg for a single by Rahim.
On the stumps, Sabbir solidly defends it.
Floated on off, Rahman blocks it.
Sabbir Rahman walks out to bat now.

OUT! Kuldeep gets a much-needed wicket. Beautifully bowled this by Kuldeep. He nicely tosses it up on off and the ball spins in wonderfully to the right-hander. Mahmuduallh comes down the track and looks to hit it over the bowler's head but gets nowhere close to the ball. The ball goes onto hit the leg stump. This might be the wicket that will end the debate regarding the spinner's form and will boost his confidence.
FOUR! Not in control of the shot but gets a boundary. Kuldeep floats it on middle, Mahmudullah looks to play the upper cut but it goes off the edge but over the slip fielder's head for a boundary.
Tossed up on middle, Musfiqur nudges it to long on for one.
Tossed up around off, Mahmudullah paddles it behind square and gets a single.
Kuldeep comes back on.
Flighted on off, Mahmudullah defends it with soft hands towards cover for one.
Right in the line of the stumps, Mahmudullah defends it.
On the pads, Rahim flicks it to deep square leg for one.
On middle and leg, Mahmudullah flicks it to mid-wicket and gets one.
Floated on off, Mahmudullah gets on his front foot and defends it.
Flatter on off, Mahmudullah defends it.
Mushfiqur has taken the aerial route and played that over the covers. They manage to come back for the second.
Slower through the air on middle, Rahim comes inside the line before mistiming his shot towards short fine leg. Goes aerially but Bhuvneshwar is content to stay back and field into on a bounce.
The batsman dances down the track and does well to block the ball.

FOUR! He is a master of the square cut against spin yells Manjrekar on air and is he or what? A short ball outside off, Rahim backs away and slashes this ball wide of point. Finds the gap and the fence as well.
Flighted on off, driven hard to cover by Rahim but the ball goes straight to the fielder.
Flatter on middle, tucked away to mid-wicket for a single by Mahmudullah.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Rahim makes room and cuts this ball to the point fielder.

FOUR! Top edge and four! Good ball from Jadeja but goes in vain. Flighted outside off, Rahim looks to sweep it away but the ball goes off the top edge and over Dhoni. The ball races away from Kuldeep who gives chase.
The Bangladeshi wicket-keeper batsman gets to the pitch of the ball and defends it.
The batsman has pushed it to the cover region. One run added to the total.
A flatter one fired in on the pads, run down to fine leg for a single by Mushfiqur.
Bowled flatter on the pads, the batsman runs it down fine on the leg side to short fine leg.
No hat-trick! A really good ball though. Bowled full on middle, Mahmudullah does well to keep it out.
Mahmudullah walks out to bat next and face the hat-trick ball.

OUT! Two in two balls, the second time this innings. Mithun departs on the first ball he faces and Chahal gets his second wicket. A googly first up landing outside off and spinning inward, Mohammad looks to flick it away but misses the ball. Gets rapped low and right in front of middle stump on the back pad. The finger goes up in an instant. Double blow for the Tigers.

Drinks break! The 3rd wicket has fallen just before the break. A really good but slow stand between Das and Musfiqur means that even though Bangladesh have a decent look on the scorecard, it is not good in the context of the game. They now need 191 in 111 balls and it is really difficult. They would not mind though as in my opinion they were trying to gain as much batting practice off this game as possible. Meanwhile, Mohammad Mithun walks out to bat now.

OUT! Stumped! The blow has caused a loss in concentration from Liton Das. A flighted leg spinner outside off, Das comes down the ground to lift it over covers but the ball spins away and beats his bat. Dhoni completes the formalities as Liton has no chance of coming back. The stand of 120 is broken! It was a good stand but off the pace required from it a bit.
Pushed down to long off for a single now. Smart batting.
FOUR! Swept away wide of deep mid-wicket. A flighted ball on middle, Rahim gets really low and plays the sweep beautifully in front of square. Beats the fielder in the deep.
Liton Das has got hit on the neck. He is in pain. The physio is out in the middle having a check on him. Bangladesh must be praying that he is fine and it's nothing more than just a blow.

Ouch! That must have hurt! A flighted ball outside off, turn and bounce! Das looks to paddle it fine on the leg side but misses the ball and it goes and hits his Adam's apple. Must be painful! Immediately removes the helmet and goes to the side!
Rahim has flicked the ball off his pads. The batsmen have run through for a single.
Cut away uppishly towards the point fielder by Rahim.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Short outside off, MR tries to cut the ball away but fails to put bat on ball.
Rahim stands in his crease and defends this ball.
Flighted full toss on middle, run down to long on along the ground for a single.
The batsman got into position early and reverse swept that one but straight to the third man fielder in the circle.
Cut away to deep cover for a run by Das.
Flighted on middle, a watchful defense from Rahim follows. A quick single is pinched.
Flighted outside off, swept away by Das to deep mid-wicket for a run.
Shorter outside off, cut away by Das but finds the point fielder.
Short outside off, MR cuts it straight to point.
On the pads, Das works it down to fine leg for one.
Floated on middle and leg, Liton drives it to mid on.
Tossed up- on the stumps, LD once again defends it with authority.
On the middle, Das defends it off the front foot.
Short on middle, Rahim pulls it to deep mid-wicket for a single.
MR runs this one down to long off for a single. Keeps strike for the next over.
Mushfiqur punches this away towards cover.
Rahim flicks this flatter one on middle towards mid-wicket.
Flatter outside off, punched off the back foot to deep cover. Single taken.
Pushed off the back foot to point by LD.
FOUR! Short and pulled away. A drag down from Chahal on middle, Das goes back in his crease before pulling it away wide of deep mid-wicket for a boundary.
Pushed away to deep cover for a run.
FOUR! That is a lovely shot. Flighted on middle, Liton comes down the track and lifts the ball over mid-wicket. The ball beats the fielder in the deep easily. Liton is looking really good here.
Liton pushes this ball towards the left of the bowler where Jadeja runs and stops the ball.
Slower on middle stump, Mushfiqur tucks it away through square leg for a single.
Pulled away to deep backward square leg for a single by Liton. Moves into the 60s.
Flatter on middle and leg, Das defends this towards cover.
Ravindra Jadeja is now on.
On middle and leg, Rahim flicks it to the man at mid-wicket.
On the pads, Das looks to flick but it goes off the thigh pad and they take a leg bye.
FOUR! Once again Das plays the sweep and gets a boundary. He gets a tossed up ball on off, Liton sweeps it towards backward square leg and gets a boundary.
Shorter on off, Das punches it to the man at cover.
Better ball this. Chahal tosses this leg spinner on off, Das looks to hit it but misses.
Shorter on off, Das plays it late down to short third man.
Good length ball on off, Rahim blocks it to see off the over. 24 runs have come off the last two.
Length ball outside off, Das runs it down to third man and gets a single.
Shorter on off, Mushfiqur pulls it towards fine leg and gets to the other end.

FOUR! What a shot! Nothing wrong with the delivery. He bowls it on a length around off. But Rahim is in such good form that he makes this look like a bad ball and drives it through covers for a boundary.
On the pads, Rahim flicks it wide of deep mid-wicket and gets a couple.
SIX! Rahim comes down the track and smacks this length ball from Shankar over the long off fence for a maximum.

FOUR! Swept and swept hard. Chahal tosses it up on off, Das gets on his knee and sweeps it wide of Dhawan at deep square leg. He was well inside the rope. Had he been on the edge he might have had a chance.
Floated on the stumps, Das blocks it off the front foot.

FOUR! Fifty for Liton Das. He does not get there in a convincing fashion but he will take it. Shorter leg spinner pitching around off, Das looks to cut but gets a thick outside edge. It goes wide of the first slip and to the vacant third man region for a boundary.
Floated on middle, Rahim milks it to long on and gets a run.
Googly on off, Das plays it late down to third man for a single.
Slider on the pads, Das looks to flick but gets hit on the pad.
On top of middle, pushed with an open face towards cover.
Run down to third man for a single by Das.
Bowled on a length on middle, turned away to deep square leg for a run by MR.
Bowled on the pads, Mushfiqur looks to flick it away but gets a thick inside edge on the pad. The ball rolls on the leg side towards the mid-wicket fielder.
Das runs down the track and then works this away to deep mid-wicket for a single.
Bowled on a length outside off, Rahim pushes this to the right of point for a single.
On the pads, Rahim sweeps it to deep square leg and keeps the strike.
Flights it on off, Das nudges to long off for a simple single.
Floated on the stumps, Liton blocks it off the front foot.
On the pads, Rahim looks to turn it around off the hips but he gets hit on the thigh pad and they take a leg bye.
Short again. This time on middle, Mushfiqur pulls it wide of deep mid-wicket and gets a couple.
Starts with a shorter on the body, Mushfiqur strokes it to the man at cover.
Yuzvendra Chahal comes into the attack now.
On the pads, Mushfiqur turns it down to square leg and gets a single. He will keep the strike.
Back of a length ball on off, Das pulls it to deep mid-wicket for a single.
Good length ball on off, LD defends it off the back foot.
Excellent fielding from Rohit Sharm. Fuller on middle, Liton flicks it to the right of Rohit at mid-wicket. He dives full strength to stop the ball and save runs for his side.
Good length ball on off,  Mushfiqur drives it to sweeper cover for one.
Good length ball on the pads, Das flicks it to deep mid-wicket for a run.
Mushfiqur gets low and sweeps this ball fine on the leg side. Two runs taken! A good over for Bangladesh, 11 off it in the end.
A short delivery which has been pulled away. The batsmen have run through for a single.

FOUR Leg Byes! A flighted ball outside off, Liton gets well inside the line of the ball and looks to sweep. He misses and it goes off the pads fine on the leg side. It runs away to the fence. Dhoni had appealed for LBW and even thinks about reviewing but then after consulting the bowler and the captain, decides not to take it upstairs. The 50-run stand comes up with those leg byes.
FOUR! Good use of the feet but it was an opportunity for the bowler. Liton comes down the ground to this flighted ball outside off,
Flatter on middle defended well by the batsman back down the ground.
Liton is bringing another bat now. Some issue maybe after that shot when the ball hit the previous bat really low.
Flighted outside off, taken on the full by Das and hit back to the bowler.
Once again plays it straight to the man at cover.
Full on off, Rahim drives it straight to the man at cover.
On the pads, Liton looks to flick it to the leg side but it goes off his thigh pad and they take a leg bye.
Full on off, Das drives it hard but straight to the man at cover.
Follows it up with a simple single with a flick down the leg side.
FOUR! Poor start from Shankar. He bowls a length ball outside off, Mushfiqur just easily guides it down to the vacant third man region for a boundary.
Vijay Shankar has been brought on now.
On the pads once again, MR flicks it to square leg and keeps the strike with a single.
Tossed up on middle, Liton comes down the track and hits it to the right of long on for a run.
On the pads, Rahim turns it to fine leg and gets one.
Floated on off, Mushfiqur drives it straight to mid off.
Flighted on off, Rahim gets on hi front foot and blocks it.
Low full toss on off, Liton strokes it to long off for a single.
A length ball on the pads, Rahim looks to flick this away. The ball though misses the bat and goes onto the thigh pad. Dot ball.
Defended towards point by the Bangladesh wicket-keeper batsman.
Ooh! Well played by Rahim in the end. A length ball outside off that keeps low. Mushfiqur manages to stay low somehow and keep the ball out.
Wide! Bowled down the leg side by Bhuvneshwar. It is wided by the umpire.
Defended back to the bowler this time.
FOUR! Rahim takes the risk and it pays off. A length ball on off, Mushfiqur runs down the track before lifting the ball over mid off. It takes a couple of bounces before going to the rope.
Good ball! On a length outside off, Rahim looks to push this away on the off side but the ball goes past the outside edge due to the slight away movement.
Bowled flatter on middle and leg, pushed down to long on for a run by Mushfiqur.
Lots of air on this outside off, driven to cover by Rahim.
Flatter on middle, worked towards mid-wicket by Rahim.
Punched off the back foot towards cover by MR.
Liton runs down the track and pushes this ball down the ground for a single.
Das pushes this off the back foot to point.

Drinks break! MS Dhoni is seen running in wearing the wicket-keeping gloves and the helmet! A solid start it was from Bangladesh but two wickets in two balls by Bumrah meant the Indians got back on top. The current pair has added 25 for the Tigers and they would need to go big as well as fast now if they are to scale the big target in front of them. Will they? India, on the other hand, will now look to choke Bangladesh with spin. An interesting passage of play ahead!
What a jaffa! Outswinger outside off, Rahim looks to push it away on the off side but the ball moves away as it whizzes past the outside edge.
Back of a length and on top of middle. Defended onto the surface.
On a length outside off, pushed towards point on the back foot by Rahim.
Pushed to deep cover on the back foot by Liton. The batsman wants the second run to come back on strike but is sent back by his partner wisely.
The batsman defends it from within the crease.
FOUR! Short on middle, Liton pulls this away over mid-wicket. The ball reaches the boundary even though it is not too well-timed.

Flatter on leg and going straight on. Mushfiqur sweeps but does not time the ball too well. He gets it off the top half and down to fine leg for a couple of runs. There is a slight appeal from Kuldeep as he thought that went off the pads but the umpire says it is off the bat.
Good fielding off his own bowling! A flighted ball outside off, driven back to the left of the bowler where Yadav dives and stops the ball.
Flatter outside off, dabbed down fine past slip by Rahim. He comes back for the second run.
Driven away to long off for a single.
Flighted on middle, taken on the full by Das as he flicks this away to deep mid-wicket for a couple of runs.
Flatter outside off, chopped towards the point fielder.
Good ball! A length ball outside off, some away swing. Das pushes at the ball and gets a thick outside edge that goes through the vacant gully region for a single down to third man.
Short again, this time Rahim keeps the ball down with a controlled pull down to deep square leg for a run.
FOUR! Short ball! Not enough pace to trouble the batsman and Rahim pulls this away through mid-wicket with ease. Finds the fence.
Cut away but straight to the point fielder by Mushfiqur.
Defended this time on the front foot by MR to cover.
Back of a length outside off, defended from the crease by Rahim.
Another flighted ball outside off, defended towards cover by the batsman.
Slower through the air on the pads, turned away to deep mid-wicket for a single.
Worked away to deep mid-wicket for a single by Das.
Driven through mid-off by the batsman. They pick up a single.
Bowled flighted on off, the batsman defends it towards mid-wicket. Kohli there fields and fires a direct hit, unneccesary throw at the striker's end. Ends up conceding an extra run.
Flatter one on the pads, turned away to deep mid-wicket for a run by Mushfiqur.
Kuldeep Yadav comes onto bowl now.
Run down to third man for a single by MR. He will keep strike for the next over.
Back of a length on off, Mushfiqur looks to defend coming ahead but the ball bounces really awkwardly after landing on a length and catches Rahim high on the thigh pad.
Good length ball on top of middle, defended with soft hands towards point by Rahim.
Quick single! A pat down to mid on by Liton and he runs through for a quick one. The 50 comes up for Bangladesh.
Defended off the back foot back to the bowler.
On a length outside off, pushed towards cover by Das on the back foot.
Powerplay 2 time! 4 fielders will be allowed outside the 30-yard circle now till the end of the 40th over.

Good length ball outside off, Rahim lets it carry to the keeper. Does not get the hat-trick but boy, can you ever count him out? He did not have the best of starts but he has comeback like a champion.
Mushfiqur Rahim walks out to face the hat-trick ball! Two slips and a gully in place!

OUT! Bowled 'em! That is some ball from Bumrah. It is not the first time he has bowled a superb yorker but whenever he does it is just awesome to watch. It is on middle and leg, Shakib looks to play it but gets beaten comprehensively. He goes without troubling the scorers. It has been a rare bad day for Shakib with both the bat and ball. Luckily for Bangladesh it has come in a warmup game and not the actual tournament. Bumrah is on a hat-trick now.
Shakib Al Hasan walks out at number 3.

OUT! Bumrah strikes! Just like he has in so many occasions. Good length ball outside off, the ball comes in after pitching. Sarkar looks to cut but gets a feather of an inside edge. Dinesh Karthik behind the stumps takes an easy catch. Bumrah and all the other Indian players go up in appeal. The umpire thinks for a bit but then finally raises his finger. They check for the no ball and it is clean so Sarkar continues his walk back.
Fuller on off, Soumya drives it to the man at cover.
On middle and leg, Das flicks it towards mid-wicket and gets a single.
Bumrah hits the deck hard and the ball jags back in sharply after pitching. Liton looks to flick but gets an inside edge onto his pads.
On middle and off, Das drives it wide of mid on and gets a single.

In the air...but just short of the fielder. Good length ball outside off, Liton shuffles across and flicks it uppishly towards mid-wicket. Yuzvendra Chahal dives in front in an attempt to take the catch but the ball was short of him.
Once again the length is the same but it is on the stumps, Das blocks it.
Better line and length this. Full on off, Liton taps it back to the bowler.
Length ball on the pads once again, Liton flicks it to mid-wicket.
Starts with a length ball on the pads. There is a hint of inswing for Bhuvi on offer. Das looks to flick but the ball clips his pad on its way to Dinesh Karthik behind.
Bhuvneshwar Kumar comes onto bowl now.
Good length on middle and off, Sarkar defends it off the lower half of his bat.
WIDE!  Bumrah has to reload that again. He bowls it down the leg side, Sarkar looks to flick but misses. Wide signalled.
Back of a length ball on off, Sarkar blocks it.
Now follows it up with a composed single by guiding down the third man.
FOUR! The idea to intimidate Das with a bouncer backfires. Bumrah bangs it in short, Liton gets on top of the bounce and whacks his pull over mid-wicket for a boundary.
FOUR! Excellent shot! Full outside off, Liton saw the mid off was inside the circle so he just drives it through mid off for a boundary.
Good length ball on middle, Soumya tucks it to mid-wicket and gets one.
From around the wicket, on a length outside off. Sarkar backs away and angles this ball away to third man for a run.
Liton opens the face of the bat and helps it to third man. The batsmen have run through for a single.
Bouncer outside off, Das looks to pull it away but the ball bounces too much and goes over the bat.
Pushed towards cover by Das coming ahead. Kohli there fields the ball well on a bounce.
On a length outside off, defended towards the left of the bowler.
Shami with a false start... seems to have missed his run-up. The second or third time today!
Back of a length on middle, Liton pats it with soft hands towards mid on and wants a single but the ball goes too quickly to the fielder.
Good length ball on off, Sarkar looks to defend but gets an inside edge onto his pads.
On off, Sarkar blocks it off the front foot.
Good length ball outside off, Soumya looks to push it but misses.

Excellent bouncer! Free Hit does not cost at all. It is on the body, Sarkar looks to play the uppercut but misses. Dinesh Karthik does really well to take the ball jumping full stretch. It looked to be an overhead wide but the square leg umpire was happy with the ball.
FREE HIT TIME!!!

NO BALL! Good length ball on off, it moves away after pitching. Sarkar looks to poke but misses. All the goodness of the ball is of no use as the umpire signals it as no ball as Bumrah overstepped. Free Hit to follow.
Brilliant fielding! Length ball around off, Sarkar taps it wide of point and looks for a run but Virat Kohli dives to his right and saves the single. Inspiring stuff from the skipper.
Good length ball on off, Soumya strokes it to mid off.
Fuller on off, Das defends it to see off the over. Just 2 off the over.
On the pads, Das flicks it to the man at mid-wicket.
Back of a length ball on off, Das blocks it off the back foot.
On off, Liton punches it to the man at cover.

Good length ball on off, Sarkar punches it wide of cover and gets a single. Jadeja rushes to the ball and has a shy at the nonstriker's end but he misses. Direct hit and it could have been trouble for Bangladesh.
Length ball coming in after pitching. Liton looks to defend but gets an inside edge which goes to the left of the keeper. Dinesh Karthik slips which allows them to take a single.
Good length ball on off, Soumya defends it to see off the over.
Back of a length ball outside off, Sarkar looks to play the upper cut but it does not raise as much as he was expecting.
FOUR! Edged but Sarkar won't mind. Good length ball going away from the southpaw. Sarkar looks to drive but gets a thick outside edge which flies through the second slip for a boundary.
FOUR! Full on off, Sarkar picks the length early and drives it through cover-point. The fielder gives it a chase but comes second best as the ball beats him to the fence.

Good ball! Pacy ball pitching on middle and comes in after pitching. Das looks to play it straight but gets hit on the thigh pad. The ball goes to the third man region off his thigh pad and they take a leg bye.
Length ball coming in after pitching. Liton defends it form within the crease.
Full on middle, Sarkar flicks it to mid on.
Good length ball on off, Sarkar defends it off the front foot.
Nowhere close to control on this shot. Length ball on off, Liton looks to run it down to third man but end up french cutting it to fine leg for one.
FOUR! Good shot. Length ball outside off, Das hits it over point. He was in control of that shot all along and gets a boundary.
Good length ball on the body, Sarkar taps it towards point and gets a single.
Excellent ball. It comes in with the angle but as it hits the deck it moves away from the batsman. Sarkar looks to defend but gets beaten all ends up.
SS runs it down to third man for a single and keeps strike for the next over.

Oooh! Almost chopped on. A back of length on off, Soumya Sarkar looks to punch the ball away but gets a under edge. The ball bounces over the stumps. Sarkar was worried at one moment and even almost tried to use his hand to push the ball away. Not the smartest thing to do.
Yorker length ball outside off, sliced away to deep third man to his left for a couple by the southpaw.

That is so lucky! A length ball coming in with the angle from outside off, Liton is surprised by the movement and awkwardly looks to jab it out. The ball takes the inside edge and goes past leg stump. Lucky! Single down to fine leg.
Good ball on off, slightly back of a length. Das defends it back down the ground to the bowler.
That has pinged off the bat but straight to point. A length ball outside off. Good bounce on that one, pushed off the meat of the blade to point by Liton.
Jasprit Bumrah has the other new ball in his hand.

SIX! This is even better! Shami overcompensates his length and bowls it short. Sarkar was waiting for it and he just guides it over the slip's head over the third man fence for a maximum. 12 runs off the first over. Solid start from Bangladesh.
FOUR! What a way to get off the mark. Shami overpitches it on off, Sarkar gets on his front foot and drives it exquisitely through mid off for a boundary.
WIDE! Shami bowls it way outside off, Sarkar looks cut it but gets nowhere close to the ball. Wide signalled.
Good length ball on the pads, Sarkar flicks it to the man at mid-wicket.
Edge but safe. Length ball outside off, Sarkar looks to cut but gets an outside edge which goes to first slip on the bounce.
Good length ball and some swing away from the batsman. Liton strokes it to third man and gets the chase underway.
Shami starts with a good length ball on middle, Liton defends it strongly off the front foot.

We are back for the chase. The umpires walk out followed by the Indian team. Dinesh Karthik will be donning the keeper's gloves just like the first warm-up game for India. The two openers for Bangladesh are Liton Das and Soumya Sarkar. No Tamim, hmmm... Liton is on strike first up and will face Mohammed Shami. Let's play!
